method: image-space pairwise proximity alerts + grid occupancy heatmap
log_sampling: every processed frame; indices a/b are not persistent track IDs
note: Alerts mean estimated box-bottom-center distance <= threshold, regardless of grid. Counts are detections per processed frame, not unique visitors. Feet are estimates. No calibration, motion analysis, or temporal confirmation. Proximity does not establish an emergency. Occupancy color saturates at 5 and never triggers an alert. Frame percentages refer only to processed frames.
